constraints.ocl:
context MaintenanceTask
inv: self.isDone implies self.assignedTo <> null

context WorkOrder
inv: (self.plannedQuantity >= 1) and (self.qualityChecks->forAll(v | v.passed = true))

context Machine
inv: (self.serialNumber <> '') and (self.maintenanceTasks->forAll(v | v.isDone = false))

context DefectReport
inv: (self.qualityCheck.passed) and (self.description <> '' and self.description.size() > 0)

context Machine
inv: (self.sensors->any(x | x.lastReading >= 2) <> null) and (self.serialNumber.toLowerCase() = 'test')

context Plant
inv: (self.inventory->any(x | x.quantity < 100) <> null) and (self.suppliers->isEmpty())

context BOMItem
inv: self.requiredQty >= 44 and self.requiredQty <= 90

context BOMItem
inv: (self.requiredQty mod 5 = 0) and (self.requiredQty mod 2 = 0)

context DefectReport
inv: self.severity >= 45 and self.severity <= 55

context BOMItem
inv: self.requiredQty >= 25 and self.requiredQty <= 99

context ProductionLine
inv: (self.workOrders->collect(x | x.qualityChecks)->size() >= 3) and (self.stations->exists(x | x.name <> ''))

context Shift
inv: self.startTime <> null implies self.endTime <> null

context Shift
inv: self.endTime <> null implies self.startTime <> null

context Shift
inv: self.startTime <> null and self.endTime <> null

context Shift
inv: self.endTime <> null and self.startTime <> null

context Shift
inv: (self.endTime <> self.startTime) and (self.operators->one(x | x.name <> ''))

context BillOfMaterials
inv: (self.items->collect(x | x.name)->notEmpty()) and (self.items->any(x | x.requiredQty >= 0) <> null)

context Machine
inv: (self.sensors->one(x | x.lastReading <= 100)) and (self.sensors->exists(x | x.lastReading >= 1))

context WorkOrder
inv: (self.plannedQuantity <= 100) and (self.qualityChecks->forAll(v | v.passed <> false))

context Workshop
inv: (self.name <> '') and (self.lines->forAll(v | v.isActive = true))

context Machine
inv: (self.manufacturer <> '') and (self.maintenanceTasks->forAll(v | v.isDone = false))
